title: ranunculus acris subsp. japonicus
intro: Ranunculus acris subsp. japonicus, commonly known as Japanese buttercup, is a subspecies of the Ranunculus acris plant, which belongs to the Ranunculaceae family. This perennial plant has been used in traditional medicine, and its health benefits include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as fever and pain. The therapeutic actions of Ranunculus acris subsp. japonicus include its ability to reduce inflammation, inhibit bacterial growth, and act as an antioxidant, which may contribute to its use in treating infections and promoting wound healing. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and volatile oils, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
